'''Rier'let''' was a small mountain located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Along with the similarly named [[Rier'vem]] mountain, it bordered the [[Agrilat Region|Agrilat Swamp]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rier'let is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
